messages:
Iris: quick sync 1 opened a PR to reconcile a few doc-term clashes across the migration guide + SDK quickstarts. Major items: 'model handle' vs 'model id', 'tool calling' vs 'function calling', and use of Title Case for product names. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/789
Tom: thanks. +1 on standardizing 'model handle' as the canonical term in code samples. 'model id' sounds ambiguous for databases. can we have a short glossary blurb?
Leah: agree. propose: glossary entry 'model handle (aka model id) - use "model handle" in code and examples; accept "model id" as a legacy alias in migration notes.' keeps search parity.
Iris: also found mixed references to 'function calling' and 'tool calling' in the same page. which do we prefer? API layer uses 'tool calling' in our spec.
Tom: product prefers 'tool calling' in public docs (consistent with SDK naming). 'function calling' is used in some research notes. Let's make 'tool calling' the default. add alias to glossary.
Leah: small style nit: product names should be Title Case when referring to the product (e.g., Redwood Dedicated) but lowercase generic phrases (e.g., dedicated capacity). I'll add a one-line rule to the style guide page.
gr ant-bot: reminder: ensure docs-glossary.yml anchors exist for 'model handle' and 'tool calling' to improve search surface. Issue created: #1012
Iris: code example in PR currently uses `model_handle: "RedwoodOpt_v2"` which we should canonicalize to kebab-case `redwood-opt-v2`. I'll update the code blocks across languages in the PR to use the canonical handle.
Tom: +1. also add a tiny note in the migration guide: "If your code references 'model id', search-and-replace with 'model handle' to match new docs. Backwards-compatible aliases remain supported in the API."
Leah: can we add one sample snippet showing mapping older naming to canonical naming? e.g.,
```
# old
client.generate(model_id="RedwoodOpt_v2")
# new
client.generate(model_handle="redwood-opt-v2")
```
Iris: good idea. I'll add that and a one-liner in the PR description explaining the changeset and follow-ups: normalize SDK param names per language (separate PRs).
PMO: scheduling note: if this merges before Friday, we can include the glossary anchor changes in the weekly site build; otherwise it'll be next week's rollout.
Iris: marked for Friday merge window. thanks everyone :sparkles:
